exceptions.name: SearchIndexCorruptedError
exceptions.trigger: Search index database or FTS5 table is damaged, corrupted, or unreadable.
exceptions.rationale: Corrupted derived views must trigger recovery rather than returning invalid search results.

exceptions.name: SearchProvenanceMissingError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to emit a search result without valid source_ref or source_watermark.

exceptions.name: SearchQuerySyntaxError
exceptions.trigger: Search query syntax is invalid or violates query parser grammar.

exceptions.name: SearchIndexRebuildOrderError
exceptions.trigger: Search rebuild invoked without access to authoritative CoreStore.
exceptions.rationale: Derived view rebuild requires authoritative sources.

exceptions.name: MemoryNotFoundError
exceptions.trigger: Requested memory item ID does not exist in store.

exceptions.name: MemoryStateTransitionError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted illegal transition on memory item lifecycle.

exceptions.name: MemorySourceRewriteForbiddenError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to mutate or overwrite raw record or artifact from memory operation.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 3: Memory is derived, never source truth.

exceptions.name: ContextPackBudgetExceededError
exceptions.trigger: Context pack construction exceeds explicit token budget constraint.

exceptions.name: NoEligibleRouteCandidateError
exceptions.trigger: No candidates meet capability, health, or policy constraints.
exceptions.rationale: Routing failure when candidate set is empty or disqualified.

exceptions.name: RoutingExecutionAttemptForbiddenError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to dispatch or execute work directly from router.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 7: Routing selects; it does not execute.

exceptions.name: RoutingPolicyViolationError
exceptions.trigger: Routing policy configuration is invalid or missing required weights.

exceptions.name: RoutingUnknownEvidencePolicyError
exceptions.trigger: Attempted to bypass fail-safe UNKNOWN evidence policy.
exceptions.rationale: Invariant 8: UNKNOWN stays unknown per policy.
